newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Southern Steel says gets takeover notice.
newsitem.headline: Southern Steel says gets takeover notice.

text.p: Malaysia's Southern Steel Bhd said on Wednesday it has received a takeover notice from Camerlin Group Bhd.

In a statement issued by its merchant bankers, Southern Steel said Camerlin proposed to acquire the remaining shares in Southern Steel not already owned by Camerlin or parties acting in concert with it.
Camerlin, formerly Malex Industries Bhd, is mainly involved in the property rental and property-products businesses.
The statement did not mention the current equity interest held in Southern Steel by Camerlin and related parties.

In May, Camerlin issued a circular to its shareholders proposing the acquisition of 39.44 percent of the issued and paid-up capital of Southern Steel for 566 million ringgit. It plans to pay for the acquisition by issuing 70.75 new Camerlin shares at 8.0 ringgit each.

Camerlin has proposed to offer holders of Southern Steel shares Camerlin shares valued at 8.0 ringgit each in exchange for Southern Steel shares at 5.10 ringgit each, or a cash alternative of 5.10 ringgit a share.
Southern Steel stock closed Wednesday trading at 6.75 ringgit, off 10 cents.
Camerlin stock closed at 28.00 ringgit, down 1.0 ringgit.
